The '''Gymsnor-3 light freighter''' was a long, segmented [[Starship/Legends|craft]] capable of transporting 95 [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of cargo. This light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was armed with a turret-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] which gave it better protection against [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks than the old [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] in the [[Gymsnor-2 light freighter]], its precursor. In addition, the ship's entire forward cockpit module could be detached as an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Unfortunately, the placement of the laser gave it large blind spots which pirates could exploit. [[CorelliSpace]] designed this freighter to compete with the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], but these aspirations failed. The Gymsnor-3 was very rare outside [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
